preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 1000 and 2 <= M <= 1000 and isinstance(N, int) and isinstance(M, int) for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N and M are integers between 2 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(B) == N * M and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in B) and len(set(B)) == len(B) for B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, B is an array of N*M distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(len(grid) == N and len(grid[0]) == M and all(isinstance(row, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in row) for row in grid) for grid, N, M in zip(output_grids, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output grid is an N x M matrix of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(set(sum(grid, [])) == set(B) for grid, B in zip(output_grids, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output grid contains all elements of B exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(min_score(grid, N, M) == min_possible_score(B, N, M) for grid, B, N, M in zip(output_grids, test_cases, test_cases))
postconditions.description: The score of each output grid is minimized, where the score is defined as the difference between the maximum and minimum elements visited by the car during its path from (1,1) to (N,M).
